name: The Boar
setup: A safe village does not mean a safe boar. It has not run and it is not going to, and the distance between you is now its decision rather than yours.

opponent.name: a valley boar
opponent._poolsDerived_20260905: health removed: it was on the retired 3-7 scale and overrode a live synthesised sheet, which made a bout end in a median of ONE turn. The pool now derives from standing (30 + 5/level) through the level the threat implies. `yieldAtFraction` replaces an absolute `yieldAt` because a ratio is scale-free.

lethalNote: Erik's ruling 2026-07-19: wild animals are lethal — they are. Defeat here is not incapacitation. The stakes dial (SNG-170) governs whether a profile meets them at all, not whether a boar can kill.
